summary: Boston Scientific has formed an alliance with Blackstone Life Sciences to co-fund development of its Vitalyst miniature heart pump. Blackstone, which disclosed the agreement Monday, will provide up to $455 million in return for potential regulatory and commercial milestone payments, plus royalties on net sales. Boston Scientific focused on developing Vitalyst in acute myocardial infarction cardiogenic shock following setbacks to Johnson & Johnson’s rival Impella pump in another indication.
